artworks.title: Athena Parthenos (reconstruction)
artworks.description: A marble statuette regarded as the most faithful surviving copy of the colossal gold-and-ivory Athena Parthenos that Phidias created for the Parthenon. The goddess stands fully armed, a winged Nike on her outstretched hand and her shield resting at her side. It is held in the National Archaeological Museum, Athens.

artworks.title: The Mourning Athena
artworks.description: A small marble relief showing Athena, helmeted and leaning on her spear, bowing her head before an upright stele. Its quiet, pensive pose has made it one of the most touching images of the goddess to survive from the Classical period. It is displayed in the Acropolis Museum, Athens.

artworks.title: Pallas Athene
artworks.description: An oil painting of Athena in gleaming golden armor, the gorgoneion on her breast and a small nude figure of victory in her hand, her gaze level and unyielding. Painted at the height of the Vienna Secession, it became an emblem of the movement. It is held by the Wien Museum, Vienna.

films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's Athena arms Perseus for the quest — owl, shield and divine counsel — the goddess of strategy as the hero's Olympian quartermaster.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries keeps Athena as Odysseus' steadfast advocate, steering the nostos while Poseidon rages — the grey-eyed goddess of the poem made flesh for television.

music.title: Il pomo d'oro
music.description: Cesti's colossal Viennese festa teatrale stages the Judgement of Paris and the golden apple: Athena among the three goddesses whose quarrel lights the road to Troy.

music.title: The Golden Apple
music.description: Broadway's through-sung Homer pastiche casts Athena in the angel-food contest for the golden apple — wisdom arguing its case in a Washington-state town fair.

popCulture.title: Hades
popCulture.creator: Supergiant Games
popCulture.description: Athena's boons in Supergiant's underworld run are all deflection and disciplined strike — the goddess of strategy as a build you can feel in the dash.
